faq_heading: Tsawwassen North houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Tsawwassen North sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Tsawwassen North between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,515,080.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Tsawwassen North?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Tsawwassen North sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 11 houses that sold in Tsawwassen North went for between $1,171,750 and $1,645,000, around a median of $1,515,080.

faq.q: Do houses in Tsawwassen North sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 11 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 98.0% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Tsawwassen North?
faq.a: The median year built was 2017 for the 11 houses sold in Tsawwassen North.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Tsawwassen North usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Tsawwassen North had 3 bedrooms, from the 11 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Tsawwassen North houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

11 houses sold in Tsawwassen North with a median price of $1,515,080 (the middle half sold between $1,171,750 and $1,645,000), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $797 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median lot of 4,146 square feet.
How Tsawwassen North compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Tsawwassen North sold for $1,515,080, about the same as the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Tsawwassen North houses took a median 20 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
